engineeringGuide.title: Custom Medal Engineering & Specifications
engineeringGuide.lede: Consider these four metallurgical and aesthetic parameters when designing custom medals for your championship:

factors.title: 1. Medal Diameter & Thickness
factors.detail: For standard school events, 50mm–60mm (3.5mm thick) provides the ideal balance of size and budget. For state championships and marathons, 65mm–75mm (4.0mm–5.0mm thick) delivers massive podium impact.

factors.title: 2. 2D Flat vs 3D Sculpted Relief
factors.desc: Single-plane graphic lines vs multi-level 3D contours.
factors.detail: 3D sculpted relief allows rounded human muscle contours, architectural elevations, and curved animal mascots that cannot be represented in flat 2D lines.

factors.title: 3. Custom Satin Ribbon Width
factors.detail: Our standard 25mm–30mm silky polyester satin ribbons support double-sided full-color dye sublimation for sponsor logos, event dates, and dynamic gradient artwork.

factors.title: 4. Plating & Color Enamel Infill
factors.desc: Antique metal finish vs soft enamel color accents.
factors.detail: Choose Antique Gold/Silver/Bronze for traditional prestige, or add vibrant Pantone-matched soft enamel infills for multi-colored federation logos.

faqs.title: Frequently Asked Questions About Custom Medals
faqs.lede: Direct answers regarding zinc alloy weight, custom neck ribbons, production timelines, and plating finishes:

faqs.q: What is the weight and feel of zinc alloy medals compared to iron or plastic?
faqs.a: Zinc alloy is heavy, solid, and dense, giving a luxury feel when worn around the neck. Unlike stamped iron, zinc allows intricate 3D rounded contours and cutouts without rusting.

faqs.q: Can we print custom text or sponsor logos on the neck ribbons?
faqs.a: Yes! Our satin ribbons are printed using high-definition dye sublimation, allowing full-color gradient logos, event dates, and sponsor names on both sides.

faqs.q: What is the typical production timeline for custom medals?
faqs.a: Custom mold die-casting typically takes 7–10 days for production and dispatch from our Guwahati regional hub.

faqs.q: What diameters and thicknesses are available for custom medals?
faqs.a: We manufacture standard 50mm, 60mm, 65mm, and 75mm medal diameters with thicknesses ranging from 3.0mm to 5.0mm for a deep, high-relief sculpted effect.

faqs.q: Do you supply complete Gold, Silver, and Bronze podium sets?
faqs.a: Yes, we provide matching 1st, 2nd, and 3rd place podium medal sets with coordinated Antique Gold, Antique Silver, and Antique Bronze electroplating.
